versos.hebraico: הֲיָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֭ת לֶ֣דֶת יַעֲלֵי־סָ֑לַע חֹלֵ֖ל אַיָּל֣וֹת תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃

controles.web: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
controles.kjv: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
controles.livre: Sabes tu o tempo em que as cabras montesas dão filhotes? Ou observaste tu as cervas quando em trabalho de parto?

versos.hebraico: תִּסְפֹּ֣ר יְרָחִ֣ים תְּמַלֶּ֑אנָה וְ֝יָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֣ת לִדְתָּֽנָה׃

controles.web: Can you number the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
controles.kjv: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
controles.livre: Contaste os meses que elas cumprem, e sabes o tempo de seu parto?

versos.hebraico: תִּ֭כְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶ֣ן תְּפַלַּ֑חְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶ֥ם תְּשַׁלַּֽחְנָה׃

controles.web: They bow themselves, they bear their young. They end their labor pains.
controles.kjv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
controles.livre: Quando se encurvam, produzem seus filhos, e lançam de si suas dores.

versos.hebraico: יַחְלְמ֣וּ בְ֭נֵיהֶם יִרְבּ֣וּ בַבָּ֑ר יָ֝צְא֗וּ וְלֹא־שָׁ֥בוּ לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
controles.kjv: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
controles.livre: Seus filhos se fortalecem, crescem como o trigo; saem, e nunca mais voltam a elas.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־שִׁלַּ֣ח פֶּ֣רֶא חָפְשִׁ֑י וּמֹסְר֥וֹת עָ֝ר֗וֹד מִ֣י פִתֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
controles.kjv: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
controles.livre: Quem despediu livre ao asno montês? E quem ao asno selvagem soltou das ataduras?

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֣מְתִּי עֲרָבָ֣ה בֵית֑וֹ וּֽמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֥יו מְלֵֽחָה׃

controles.web: Whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
controles.kjv: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
controles.livre: Ao qual eu dei a terra desabitada por casa, e a terra salgada por suas moradas.

versos.hebraico: יִ֭שְׂחַק לַהֲמ֣וֹן קִרְיָ֑ה תְּשֻׁא֥וֹת נ֝וֹגֵ֗שׂ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָֽע׃

controles.web: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
controles.kjv: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
controles.livre: Ele zomba do tumulto da cidade; não ouve os gritos do condutor.

versos.hebraico: יְת֣וּר הָרִ֣ים מִרְעֵ֑הוּ וְאַחַ֖ר כָּל־יָר֣וֹק יִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: The range of the mountains is his pasture, He searches after every green thing.
controles.kjv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
controles.livre: A extensão dos montes é seu pasto; e busca tudo o que é verde.

versos.hebraico: הֲיֹ֣אבֶה רֵּ֣ים עָבְדֶ֑ךָ אִם־יָ֝לִ֗ין עַל־אֲבוּסֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?
controles.kjv: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
controles.livre: Por acaso o boi selvagem  quererá te servir, ou ficará junto de tua manjedoura?

versos.hebraico: הֲֽתִקְשָׁר־רֵ֭ים בְּתֶ֣לֶם עֲבֹת֑וֹ אִם־יְשַׂדֵּ֖ד עֲמָקִ֣ים אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
controles.kjv: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
controles.livre: Ou amarrarás ao boi selvagem com sua corda para o arado? Ou lavrará ele aos campos atrás de ti?

versos.hebraico: הֲֽתִבְטַח־בּ֭וֹ כִּי־רַ֣ב כֹּח֑וֹ וְתַעֲזֹ֖ב אֵלָ֣יו יְגִיעֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?
controles.kjv: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
controles.livre: Confiarás nele, por ser grande sua força, e deixarás que ele faça teu trabalho?

versos.hebraico: הֲתַאֲמִ֣ין בּ֭וֹ כִּי־ישוב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְֽגָרְנְךָ֥ יֶאֱסֹֽף׃

controles.web: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
controles.kjv: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
controles.livre: Porás tua confiança nele, para que ele colha tua semente, e a junte em tua eira?

versos.hebraico: כְּנַף־רְנָנִ֥ים נֶעֱלָ֑סָה אִם־אֶ֝בְרָ֗ה חֲסִידָ֥ה וְנֹצָֽה׃

controles.web: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly; but are they the feathers and plumage of love?
controles.kjv: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
controles.livre: As asas da avestruz batem alegremente, mas são suas asas e penas como as da cegonha?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תַעֲזֹ֣ב לָאָ֣רֶץ בֵּצֶ֑יהָ וְֽעַל־עָפָ֥ר תְּחַמֵּֽם׃

controles.web: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
controles.kjv: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
controles.livre: Ela deixa seus ovos na terra, e os esquenta no chão,

versos.hebraico: וַ֭תִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־רֶ֣גֶל תְּזוּרֶ֑הָ וְחַיַּ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה תְּדוּשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.
controles.kjv: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
controles.livre: E se esquece de que pés podem os pisar, e os animais do campo podem os esmagar.

versos.hebraico: הִקְשִׁ֣יחַ בָּנֶ֣יהָ לְּלֹא־לָ֑הּ לְרִ֖יק יְגִיעָ֣הּ בְּלִי־פָֽחַד׃

controles.web: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
controles.kjv: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
controles.livre: Age duramente para com seus filhos, como se não fossem seus, sem temer que seu trabalho tenha sido em vão.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִשָּׁ֣הּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ חָכְמָ֑ה וְלֹא־חָ֥לַק לָ֝֗הּ בַּבִּינָֽה׃

controles.web: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
controles.kjv: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
controles.livre: Porque Deus a privou de sabedoria, e não lhe repartiu entendimento.

versos.hebraico: כָּ֭עֵת בַּמָּר֣וֹם תַּמְרִ֑יא תִּֽשְׂחַ֥ק לַ֝סּ֗וּס וּלְרֹֽכְבֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
controles.kjv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
controles.livre: Porém quando se levanta para correr,  zomba do cavalo e do seu cavaleiro.

versos.hebraico: הֲתִתֵּ֣ן לַסּ֣וּס גְּבוּרָ֑ה הֲתַלְבִּ֖ישׁ צַוָּאר֣וֹ רַעְמָֽה׃

controles.web: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
controles.kjv: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
controles.livre: És tu que dás força ao cavalo, ou que vestes seu pescoço com crina?

versos.hebraico: הְֽ֭תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּ֑ה ה֖וֹד נַחְר֣וֹ אֵימָֽה׃

controles.web: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
controles.kjv: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
controles.livre: Podes tu o espantar como a um gafanhoto? O sopro de suas narinas é terrível.

versos.hebraico: יַחְפְּר֣וּ בָ֭עֵמֶק וְיָשִׂ֣ישׂ בְּכֹ֑חַ יֵ֝צֵ֗א לִקְרַאת־נָֽשֶׁק׃

controles.web: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
controles.kjv: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
controles.livre: Ele escarva a terra, alegra-se de sua força, e sai ao encontro das armas;

versos.hebraico: יִשְׂחַ֣ק לְ֭פַחַד וְלֹ֣א יֵחָ֑ת וְלֹֽא־יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־חָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
controles.kjv: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
controles.livre: Ele zomba do medo, e não se espanta; nem volta para trás por causa da espada.

versos.hebraico: עָ֭לָיו תִּרְנֶ֣ה אַשְׁפָּ֑ה לַ֖הַב חֲנִ֣ית וְכִידֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
controles.kjv: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
controles.livre: Contra ele rangem a aljava, o ferro brilhante da lança e do dardo;

versos.hebraico: בְּרַ֣עַשׁ וְ֭רֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹֽא־יַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּי־ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃

controles.web: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
controles.kjv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
controles.livre: Sacudido-se com furor, ele escarva a terra; ele não fica parado ao som da trombeta.

versos.hebraico: בְּדֵ֤י שֹׁפָ֨ר׀ יֹ֘אמַ֤ר הֶאָ֗ח וּֽ֭מֵרָחוֹק יָרִ֣יחַ מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥עַם שָׂ֝רִים וּתְרוּעָֽה׃

controles.web: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
controles.kjv: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
controles.livre: Ao som das trombetas diz: Eia! E desde longe cheira a batalha, o grito dos capitães, e o barulho.

versos.hebraico: הֲֽ֭מִבִּינָ֣תְךָ יַֽאֲבֶר־נֵ֑ץ יִפְרֹ֖שׂ כנפו לְתֵימָֽן׃

controles.web: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
controles.kjv: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
controles.livre: Por acaso é por tua inteligência que o gavião voa, e estende suas asas para o sul?

versos.hebraico: אִם־עַל־פִּ֭יךָ יַגְבִּ֣יהַּ נָ֑שֶׁר וְ֝כִ֗י יָרִ֥ים קִנּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
controles.kjv: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
controles.livre: Ou é por tua ordem que a água voa alto e põe seu ninho na altura?

versos.hebraico: סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַֽל־שֶׁן־סֶ֝֗לַע וּמְצוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: On the cliff he dwells, and makes his home, on the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.
controles.kjv: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
controles.livre: Nas penhas ela mora e habita; no cume das penhas, e em lugares seguros.

versos.hebraico: מִשָּׁ֥ם חָֽפַר־אֹ֑כֶל לְ֝מֵרָח֗וֹק עֵינָ֥יו יַבִּֽיטוּ׃

controles.web: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
controles.kjv: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
controles.livre: Desde ali espia a comida; seus olhos avistam de longe.

versos.hebraico: ואפרחו יְעַלְעוּ־דָ֑ם וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חֲ֝לָלִ֗ים שָׁ֣ם הֽוּא׃פ

controles.web: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
controles.kjv: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
controles.livre: Seus filhotes sugam sangue; e onde houver cadáveres, ali ela está.
